$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). The `default` keywords here are exactly the constant defaults of 1.8's Site table; the reference canonicalizer reads them as its table of constant defaults (9.2 step 1).
title: Site
description: 1.8: the project's site. A project with no site yet omits it. It is not an element: it carries no name and no extensions.

trueNorth.title: True north
trueNorth.description: 1.8: the angle (2.4) from project north (+Y) to true north, counter-clockwise positive, in microdegrees. It MUST be greater than −180,000,000 and at most 180,000,000 (FS-CORE-1.8.1).

location.title: Location
location.description: 1.8: the site's WGS 84 position in microdegrees. Absent by default; when present, both members are present.

boundary.description: 1.8: the lot line, a polygon (2.6) in project coordinates. Absent by default.
